ratings_why.fun: Every turn asks who stands in front for plays, sells and End of Turn, and the fight is a queue I set; Tiers 1-3 are plainer than the rest.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because 'only your Front speaks' turns reading order into a timed queue of leaders, with blank Kits as timers; no tribe today or generic auto-battler plays like that.

verdict_why: One real rules gap: whether Herald picks up Loud from copied text; the rest should settle.

points.text: Herald copying Kit-Minder, Snow Hall Digger or Herding Council copies the word Loud. Say whether that makes Herald speak from any slot; it decides whether Herald is a Front card or a back-row doubler.
Old Mother Lemen prints 'From any slot' instead of Loud for her Kit rule. Calling it a Loud clause would keep the exceptions in one word, as the rationale wants.
Ole now fills only slots after himself, which makes his slot a dial: Ole in F2 floods the board, Ole in B3 gives nothing. Lovely with Lemen and as a Kit timer before Brother Onward; keep it.
Herald copying The Front Lemming: say that a second 'trigger twice' doesn't stack to four, or make it stack on purpose as the Relay's high roll.
Tiers 1-3 have one Take the Lead card (Squeaker) before Trailbreaker. A second early lead-change card would let the queue matter before Tier 3.

standouts.why: Copies the next Lemming's text, so where it sits is the card; it can make two End of Turn texts speak at once.
Turns blank Kits into copies of the Front and makes Kit-Minder a deliberate anti-synergy you keep for the crash.
Lets you choose the order your leaders die, which feeds Cantor and Onward, and is a trap in the Matriarch build.

weakest.why: A plain when-played buff; its only twist is landing it as Front.
One Kit a turn, and it fights Banner-Bearer for the single End of Turn spot.
Herding Elder does the same job as Banner-Bearer at a higher tier, with no new interaction.

flags.note: Does Herald gain Loud from copied printed text?
Golden Onward with The Front Lemming and Cantor gives twice a big Banner to everyone, twice.
With Ole and the Digger, five or more Kits copying her body plus Banner is a large in-fight board.
